$comment: K9 template check (tools/k9-check.mjs). kind: app | game. allow: items this repo still lacks, each with the reason; they are report-only (a CI warning) until added, then the entry must go (an entry for an item that exists fails).

allow.unit-tests: The game logic is one inline script in index.html, so there is no module a node unit test can import; every test runs through Playwright (tools/test-count-check.sh ratchets their number).
allow.axe-2.2: The axe checks (tests/dressup.spec.ts, tests/gfx.spec.ts) use the tags wcag2a/wcag2aa/wcag21aa only: no wcag22aa yet, so WCAG 2.2 rules (target size 2.5.8 etc.) are not asserted. Own PR (Block 0).
allow.visual-baseline: No committed toHaveScreenshot baselines yet (tests/shots.spec.ts only writes README screenshots with SHOTS=1); baselines must be generated on the Linux CI runner, so they come with their own PR.
